title: rhododendron viscosum var. tomentosum
intro: Rhododendron viscosum var. tomentosum, commonly known as Woolly Azalea, is a deciduous shrub that belongs to the heath family and is native to North America. The health benefits of Rhododendron viscosum var. tomentosum include its potential in reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which can help in wound healing, pain relief, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Rhododendron viscosum var. tomentosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
